itens.titulo: Bitcoin Drops Below $84,000 as Nearly $500 Million in Long Bets Get Wiped Out.
itens.descricao: Bitcoin Drops Below $84,000 as Nearly $500 Million in Long Bets Get Wiped Out. Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bitcoin Drops Below $84,000 as Nearly $500 Million in Long Bets Get Wiped Out.

Bitcoin dropped below $84,000 on Wednesday as a sharp crypto market pullback forced hundreds of millions of dollars in leveraged positions to close, with traders betting on higher prices taking most of the losses.
Bitcoin fell as low as about $82,880 after trading as high as roughly $86,700.
The decline triggered $555.6 million in cryptocurrency liquidations over a 24-hour period, according to CoinGlass.
Long positions accounted for $487.2 million of the total, meaning traders who had used leverage to bet on rising prices absorbed most of the forced closures.
Ether fell to around $2,550 during the selloff, while other large digital assets also moved lower.
The drop followed a strong period for Bitcoin, which had gained roughly 40% during the third quarter.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index stood at 62, classified as "greed," after falling from 67 a day earlier, according to data cited by The Block.

itens.titulo: Leilão da ANP arrecada R$ 3 bi; Petrobras leva áreas na Margem Equatorial
itens.descricao: Leilão da ANP arrecada R$ 3 bi; Petrobras leva áreas na Margem Equatorial CNN Brasil
trechos: A ANP (Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis) arrecadou R$ 3 bilhões em bônus e prevê R$ 1,58 bilhão em investimentos no 6º Ciclo da Oferta Permanente de Concessão, realizado nesta quarta-feira (7).
Ao todo, 49 blocos exploratórios para petróleo e gás foram arrematados.
Segundo o balanço apresentado na sessão pública, o ágio dos bônus foi de 3.511,27%.
A maior oferta individual de bônus alcançou R$ 754,2 milhões.
A rodada tinha 46 empresas habilitadas e colocou em oferta 308 blocos exploratórios em terra e no mar, distribuídos por 22 setores de nove bacias sedimentares.
Na Bacia de Campos, que ofereceu 36 blocos em quatro setores, houve vitórias da Petrobras e do consórcio formado por TotalEnergies e QatarEnergy.
Santos concentrou 120 blocos em dois setores, a maior quantidade entre as bacias da rodada.
Potiguar ofertou 41 blocos em cinco setores, dos quais dois ficaram sem propostas.

itens.descricao: Marvell CEO Says $30B Custom Chip Target Is ‘Not a Stretch’ – Sees Potential For $1 Trillion Valuation Yahoo Finance
trechos: "If you apply a multiple to $70 billion to $90 billion four years out, who knows what's possible," Murphy said.
MRVL stock has gained over 230% this year.
MRVL stock dipped around 1.2% in morning trade, with the S&P 500 trading lower.
The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) tumbled 0.5%, while the Nasdaq-100 tracking Invesco QQQ Trust Series 1 (QQQ) fell around 0.64%.
The Math Behind Marvell's Revenue Target At its investor day, Marvell set a fiscal 2031 revenue target of $70 billion to $90 billion.
It put custom chips at about $30 billion of that.
Murphy said the custom silicon market will reach $235 billion by 2030, and that the target is a small share of it.
"Somebody pointed out in the meeting, look, if you just divide that by the 235, it's only 13% market share," Murphy said.
